build_classifier_mlp: build an MLP or logistic regression classifier with PyTorch for sentence-level evaluation tasks
train_classifier_model: train a PyTorch classifier on labeled data with early stopping and validation monitoring
evaluate_classifier_accuracy: evaluate a trained classifier on held-out data and return classification accuracy
predict_classifier_labels: predict class labels from a trained PyTorch classifier on new input data
predict_classifier_probabilities: predict class probabilities from a trained PyTorch classifier using softmax output
